problem.title: The Frontend Paradox of Web 3.0
problem.text: Modern decentralized applications suffer from a fatal architectural contradiction. Smart contracts and tokens reside on decentralized blockchains, but the user interfaces through which humans interact with them are hosted on centralized infrastructure - AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel, Google Cloud. A single court order, a single provider's terms-of-service violation, or a single government firewall can erase any 'decentralized' application from the global internet. The frontend is the single point of failure.
problem.b1: Centralized hosting = single point of failure
problem.b3: No economic incentives for long-term availability

solution.title: Netfory: Autonomous Web 4.0 Infrastructure
solution.text: Netfory replaces the centralized hosting stack with a decentralized, content-addressed distribution network powered by the Iroh (QUIC) transport layer and BLAKE3 cryptographic verification. Through a native Proof-of-Utility economic model, network participants (seeders) are directly compensated in STH for providing storage and bandwidth.
solution.callout: A critical correction to the prevailing narrative must be stated explicitly: the network is not managed by agents. The network IS the agents. Every user's client is itself an autonomous node that discovers peers, verifies content, negotiates routes, and sustains the economy. The user's device is the agent.

architecture.title: System Architecture

formulas.title: The Four Formulas of Web 4.0
formulas.c1x: Access is a matter of connecting to a protocol (sn://, u://, sth://, dev://, api://), not having permission on a server. No server can deny access. No API key can be revoked. The protocol is the law.
formulas.c2x: State exists distributed in the network. The user does not 'download' a page; they synchronize state via P2P. There is no single source of truth - the truth is distributed.
formulas.c3x: No AWS, no Google Cloud, no Vercel. All backend logic - databases, APIs, load balancers - migrates to the P2P protocol layer. No corporation can deplatform an application.
formulas.c4x: Everything is bound to a Content Identifier (CID), computed via BLAKE3. Content proves itself. No domain can be seized. No certificate can be revoked. Content is immortal.

economics.title: Money as Anti-Spam and Motivation
economics.text: The native coin STH (SmartHoldem) is integrated directly into the protocol as both fuel and anti-spam shield. Every action that consumes network resources costs a small amount of STH. This makes spam economically devastating for attackers while simultaneously creating a perpetual revenue stream for honest participants.
economics.f1ex: For N = 1,000,000 messages at 0.01 STH each, the attacker burns 10,000 STH - a provably irrational expenditure.
economics.f2ex: A seeder with Base=5, seededGb=100, density=0.5, activeApps=10, PerApp=0.2, K_up=1.0 earns 57 STH/day = 20,805 STH/year.

quantum.title: SmartHoldem Quantum Shield
quantum.subtitle: How We Protect the Blockchain from Future Computers
quantum.text: While the market discusses charts and volatility, a threat capable of nullifying classical cryptography is maturing in the labs of tech giants. Shor's algorithm on a sufficiently powerful quantum computer could break ECDSA (elliptic curves) - the mathematical foundation on which wallets and transactions for most blockchains, including SmartHoldem, are built today.
quantum.callout: {waiting} The integration of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into the SmartHoldem ecosystem has already begun.
quantum.waitingLabel: We aren't waiting for a hypothetical "Day X."

phases.title: Implementation Plan: Hybrid Model
phases.text: We are ruling out abrupt hard forks and forced migrations. The transition will be gradual and seamless:
phases.p1b1: Transactions signed simultaneously with classic ECDSA and new PQC algorithm (e.g., Dilithium)
phases.p1b2: Even if one method is compromised, the other maintains protection
phases.p2b1: SmartHoldem node is written in TypeScript/Node.js
phases.p2b2: Integrate optimized PQC libraries in Rust or C++ via node-addon-api
phases.p2b3: Maintain high throughput of the DPoS network without sacrificing cryptographic strength
phases.p3b1: Introduction of new address type with extended public keys resistant to quantum analysis
phases.p3b2: Users can gradually transfer funds to "Quantum-Safe" wallets

sig.title: Hybrid Quantum Shield via Second Signature
sig.text: SmartHoldem leverages a unique architectural feature - the second signature mechanism, unlike many other networks where users would have to create new wallets and mass-transfer assets.
sig.s1x: An address in SmartHoldem is formed as a hash of the first public key.
sig.s2x: When the second signature is activated, a second public key is recorded on the blockchain.
sig.s3x: We replace the generation of this second key from ECDSA with a post-quantum algorithm.
sig.r1: You do not need to change your wallet
sig.r3: Your coins stay exactly where they have been for years
sig.r4: Now protected by a second cryptographic layer
sig.r5: Even if a quantum computer computes your first private key, it cannot send a transaction without a valid second (quantum-resistant) signature
sig.footer: {forUsers} You will need to either activate a second signature (which instantly enables quantum protection) or transfer funds to the new address types once they are released.
sig.forUsersLabel: For users on a single signature:

nuance.title: Technical Nuances & Network Protection
nuance.n1b1: In a DPoS network, delegates sign blocks
nuance.n1b2: Forging their signatures threatens the entire blockchain's integrity
nuance.n1b3: Implementing PQC at the protocol level makes SmartHoldem a "digital fortress" resistant to consensus spoofing
nuance.n2b1: Hash-based schemes (Lamport/SPHINCS+) generate signatures sized in kilobytes
nuance.n2b2: Node logic will be adapted to correctly process "heavy" transactions without losing sync speed
nuance.n3b1: To avoid bloating the blockchain, one-time keys will be aggregated into Merkle trees
nuance.n3b2: For the user, this looks like a familiar wallet
nuance.n3b3: At the mathematical level, each key is used strictly once and invalidated after signing

archives.p1: How do we preserve journalistic investigations, scientific records, and the documentation of civil society? In Web 2.0, a server shutdown means history is erased.
archives.p2Bold: Netfory solves the problem of long-term storage.
archives.p3: Through content-addressable architecture, archives of journalism, science, and civic memory are permanently preserved. As long as the information exists on at least one peer in the network, it cannot be destroyed.

impact.subtitle: We don't just build technology. We measure its real-world impact on human freedom.
impact.m1Text: Volume of journalistic, scientific, and civic memory stored on content-addressable infrastructure.
impact.m2Text: Number of protocols enabling users to port their social graphs freely between services.
impact.m3Text: Number of applications using censorship-resistant messaging or publishing protocols in production.
impact.m4Text: Number of active users in low-connectivity or heavily censored environments using fault-tolerant tools.

finalCta.p1: Netfory is a Web 4.0 network built for humanity. It provides universally accessible digital services, ensuring stable connectivity and all-access for people worldwide, regardless of their geography.
finalCta.quote: The era of renting your digital existence is over.
finalCta.tagline: Don't visit the web. Be the web.
